prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of CENOCROCA, the voice-mimicking beast with lion jaws and chest, donkey body, ibex horns and a solid bone instead of teeth. Fresh original composition, anatomical naturalism. Native square PNG at least 1024 pixels.
ANATOMY: Exactly ONE head and TWO eyes with pupils fixed straight ahead, TWO long ridged ibex horns arching BACKWARD above and along the neck behind the head, like natural Alpine ibex horns. TWO ears. Tawny lion head, jaws and chest; grey donkey torso, rump, two hoofed donkey hindlegs and ONE donkey tail. Two lion forelegs, FOUR legs total. The mouth slit runs through the near cheek all the way back to the near ear, and likewise on the far side. [cenocroca-c02, cenocroca-c03]
MOUTH ANATOMY: Open predator jaws in natural SIDE VIEW, dropped lower jaw and dark mouth cavity. The ivory biting edge is a SOLID CONTINUOUS SHARP BONE CRESCENT instead of teeth, seamlessly fused to the jaw. Like a smooth sharpened pale blade, not a tubular mouth ring. NO individual teeth, NO fang tips, NO grooves, NO incisions, NO tooth-shaped blocks, NO cracks or divisions in the ivory edge. An uninterrupted smooth bony blade on the visible jaws. [cenocroca-c02]
MOMENT: POUNCE diagonally toward camera, shoulders and lowered head thrust forward; head held straight ahead with both pupils fixed and glaring hard under tense brow muscles. Mouth gapes open in a predatory calling snarl rather than a smiling face. Near front paw reaching forward, far front paw bracing; both donkey hindlegs driving into rocky soil. No cartoon facial stretching. [cenocroca-c03]
POWER: It lures prey by imitating human calls; suggest this with calling gape only, no sound waves or magic. Ordinary dust kicked up from its pounce, no supernatural effects. [cenocroca-c03]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, three-quarter SIDE view revealing profile of deep open mouth and slit to the ear, both long backward horns, lion chest and complete donkey body behind. Creature fills nearly the whole frame, normal animal scale, no people.
LIGHT & WEATHER: Black NIGHT background, one hard warm light from upper side cuts across brow, catches smooth bone and fur; deep walnut shadows, suspended gritty dust. Eyes naturally lit, never glowing.
SURFACE: matted coarse tawny lion fur, rough short grey donkey hair, weathered horn ridges; polished smooth pale bone blade with ABSOLUTELY NO marks dividing it.
SETTING: minimal dark rocky ground, no documented named habitat; neutral editorial staging only. No ruins, prey, bones or invented geographical setting.
MOOD: vicious dangerous predator, hard anatomically natural face, violently forward momentum. Not comic, cute, tame, smiling, passive or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; exactly one head, two eyes, two horns, four legs, one tail; no extra limbs; no design from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons or magic fog. No ordinary lion teeth. No frontal tubular rectangular mouth rim. No ram horns curling to sides. Each ivory biting edge is one seamless smooth blade.
depicted_variant: Lion-jawed and lion-chested ass-bodied ibex-horned Cenocroca, lunging at night and calling with a seamless bone biting blade instead of teeth.

visual_requirements.description: One lion-jawed head, lion chest and ass body, four natural quadruped legs, two ibex horns, mouth split to ears with seamless bone instead of individual teeth.
Two pupils fixed straight ahead; visible focused predatory stare.
Calling mouth implies human voice imitation used to lure prey; no visible magic or sound waves.

aura: Predatory lunge, fixed straight-ahead pupils and calling ear-split jaw with bone instead of teeth (cenocroca-c02/c03); no visual magic.
artistic_choices: Fresh oblique composition chosen after two edits retained toothlike scoring; final smooth fused bone plate replaces all individual teeth. Its tapered anatomical plate edge is not a separate fang.
Four quadruped legs, paired natural ibex horns, fur colors and lion forelegs/donkey hind hooves are editorial zoological rendering of the c02 composite, not additional powers.

Night warm sidelight, coarse texture, kicked-up gravel and neutral unmarked rocky ground are editorial staging. No source documents a specific habitat; no other Crocotta/Leucrocotta anatomy is blended in.
Menace comes from the documented predatory voice-lure and fixed stare, rendered at ordinary animal scale with tight low-angle framing. Dust is mechanical contact, no supernatural effect.

rejected_attempts.reason: Mouth bone ridge broken into rectangular tooth-like segments, not one continuous bone c02; horns curl like ram rather than long backward ibex horns.
Attempt02 masih membagi tulang mulut menjadi segmen mirip gigi; mulut tidak membelah hingga telinga c02.

Anatomy is right (ass body, lion chest and head, ibex horns, mouth split to the ears with a bone ridge) but the wide toothless split mouth reads as a cartoon grin with calm eyes, i.e. comic rather than dangerous (GAMBAR §6.1 'lucu', §6.4 items 2 and 7). Redraw at night or dusk with the head lowered in a lunge, the split mouth gaping wide as it calls with a human voice, fixed glaring pupils, the bone ridge lit hard; keep every counted feature.
Night lunge and hostile eyes succeed, but ivory mouth rails have regular vertical scoring that suggests tooth divisions; horns curl sideways/downward rather than long backward ibex arcs.
Targeted edit retained repeated transverse mouth-rail divisions and lateral curling horns; fresh composition needed to remove anchor.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
